directions: Answer each question based on the text or information provided.

questions.title: Renewable-Energy Jobs in Selected Countries, 2023
questions.stimulus: Based on the table, which country likely has the greatest need for wind-turbine technicians?
options: Brazil, because it has the highest solar employment.
Germany, because it has the highest wind employment.
India, because it has the highest solar employment.
Kenya, because its wind and biofuel employment are similar.

questions.stimulus: The research team was surprised when normally timid birds began nesting near hiking trails after a strict no-feed policy was enacted. **This behavior suggests that human food had discouraged the birds from areas they otherwise preferred.**
questions.text: Which choice best revises the underlined sentence to be most precise?
options: This behavior suggests that easily available human food kept the birds away from nesting areas they otherwise preferred.
This behavior shows that birds dislike hikers in general.
This behavior means the birds prefer noise.
This behavior implies the birds had no nesting preference before.

questions.stimulus: A linguist studying endangered languages documented a verb tense used only when recounting dreams.
options: The community distinguishes dream events from waking events.
The language has no past tense.

questions.stimulus: Mars missions must account for the planet’s average temperature of −63 °C, which can plunge to −125 °C at night at the poles.
questions.text: Which revision most effectively combines the sentence parts?
options: Mars missions must account for the planet’s average temperature of −63 °C, which can plunge to −125 °C at night at the poles.
Mars missions must account for the planet’s average temperature that can plunge to −125 °C at night.
Because Mars can plunge to −125 °C at night at the poles, missions must account for its average temperature of −63 °C.
Missions must account for Mars’s temperature: its average is −63 °C, yet nighttime polar lows can reach −125 °C.
